quotes.name: Devon Willis
quotes.quote: I've noticed that having someone like Benji Dillon around can bring a lot of attention to our neighborhood, and as a server, I've seen it affect the vibe of the places I work at.

quotes.name: Grace Yamamoto
quotes.quote: I think it's interesting to consider how someone like Benji Dillon being in the neighborhood might change things for people like me, who own small businesses here. As someone who runs a bookstore, I'm used to seeing a variety of people come and go, but I can imagine that having a famous person around might bring in some new faces. I'm not sure how it would affect my daily life, but it's definitely something to think about.
